Now I understand the vulnerability. In `h3NeighborRotations`, the loop reads `oldDigit = H3_GET_INDEX_DIGIT(out, r+1)` and uses it to index into `NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]` (a `[7][7]` array). If `oldDigit` is 7 (INVALID_DIGIT), this is an out-of-bounds read.

The fuzzer reads `{H3Index index; int k;}`. We need to craft an index with an invalid digit (7) in a resolution position that gets processed by `h3NeighborRotations`.

Let me understand the H3Index bit layout. Let me look at the constants.
